one_line: Maharaja of Mysore restored as a child in 1799, ruling under British paramountcy during the early 19th century.

appearance.age_look: Looks about 30, medium height, slim but not fragile, with a composed royal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with soft jawline, light brown-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed small moustache, calm sharp eyes with slightly arched brows; default expression is dignified and thoughtful with a hint of quiet curiosity.
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and neatly combed back at the sides, mostly hidden under a rich Mysore-style royal turban in deep maroon silk with thin gold bands and a central white feather plume set in a small gold-and-emerald sarpech.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early-19th-century Mysore royal attire: a long-sleeved, knee-length angarkha-style jama of cream silk with fine vertical gold stripes, overlapping right panel tied with a concealed sash; over it a deep green silk waist-belt (kamarband) with a subtle woven motif in darker green; loose but neatly tailored churidar trousers in soft off-white cotton; on his shoulders a lightweight, gold-bordered, dark maroon silk shawl (dupatta) draped from the left shoulder across the torso and looping around his right forearm; feet in pointed brown leather mojari shoes with simple gold edging; jewellery limited to a layered pearl necklace with a central green stone pendant, a pair of small gold stud earrings, and a single thin gold bangle on the right wrist, keeping the overall look elegant yet restrained and historically plausible for a Mysore court under Company oversight.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted, sheathed ceremonial sword of the Mysore court worn at his left hip: gently curved steel blade in a plain brown leather scabbard with understated gold fittings, simple cross-guard hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, and a small green stone set at the pommel, which he often holds lightly at the hilt as a symbol of authority rather than for battle.

ref_desc: Krishnaraja Wodeyar III is a light-brown-complexioned man of about 30 with an oval face, small moustache, maroon Mysore turban with gold bands and white feather, cream-and-gold striped angarkha, maroon shawl, green waist-belt, off-white churidar, brown mojari shoes, pearl necklace, and a plain brown-sheathed curved ceremonial sword at his left hip with subtle gold fittings and a green-stoned pommel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Krishnaraja Wodeyar III: a dignified Mysore maharaja in early 19th-century Company-era India, about 30 years old, medium height, slim build, light brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, small neatly trimmed moustache, calm sharp eyes with slightly arched brows, and a composed, thoughtful default expression. His black hair is short and neat, largely covered by a rich deep maroon silk Mysore turban with thin gold bands and a central white feather plume mounted in a small gold-and-emerald sarpech. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length cream silk angarkha-style jama with fine vertical gold stripes, overlapping panel tied right over left, over off-white churidar trousers that gather at the ankles. A deep green silk waist-belt with subtle darker green pattern wraps his midsection, and a dark maroon lightweight silk shawl with a gold border is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and looping around his right forearm. On his feet are pointed brown leather mojari shoes with simple gold edging. His jewellery is modest but royal: a layered pearl necklace with a central green stone pendant, small gold stud earrings, and a thin gold bangle on his right wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature ceremonial sword, a gently curved steel blade in a plain brown leather scabbard with understated gold mounts, simple cross-guard, dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, and a small green stone in the pommel; he lightly rests one hand on the hilt as a symbol of authority. Show front, side, and back views to clearly display the maroon and gold turban, cream-and-gold striped angarkha, green waist-belt, maroon shawl, off-white churidar, brown mojari shoes, pearl necklace, and the brown-sheathed curved sword, all in a clean, shonen-anime model sheet style with consistent colours and details, without any text or labels.
